payload.name: Wayground
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Wayground helps teachers and students turn teaching and learning materials into ready-to-assign quizzes and study cards. Paste or reference instructional content, and Wayground generates aligned questions and flashcards directly from it — no need to rewrite lessons as assessments. Teachers use it to save prep time and quickly check understanding. Students use it to practice and self-check from the same material. Generated activities are delivered through Wayground, with reporting so teachers can see how students are engaging and where they need support.

payload.name: Transkriptor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Transkriptor brings your transcription library into ChatGPT.

Work with the transcripts and recordings already in your Transkriptor account—
list them, read the full text, get AI-generated summaries, download as PDF, 
and check your account details, all from a chat conversation.

Key features:

- Browse transcripts: List and filter your transcriptions by file name keyword, 
  date range, or duration.
- Read full transcripts: Fetch the complete transcript content, including 
  speaker labels and timestamps.
- AI summaries: Get concise, structured summaries of meetings, interviews, 
  lectures, podcasts, and other recorded content.
- PDF export: Generate a downloadable PDF of any transcript.
- Account overview: Check remaining transcription minutes, subscription plan, 
  and language preference.

To create new transcriptions, use Transkriptor on the web (transkriptor.com), 
iOS, or Android. Once a transcription exists in your account, this connector 
makes it easy to find, read, summarize, and share through ChatGPT.

payload.name: MetaMetrics® Lexile Analyzer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Measure the complexity of any text and receive its Lexile® measure in seconds. You can also use AI-powered text adaptation to increase or decrease the text’s complexity while preserving its meaning, helping you create versions that are more accessible or more challenging for different readers.

payload.name: Language Coach: English
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LangCoach helps you check your English level with a placement test and see your CEFR band (A1–C1). Open the app in chat to take the test, review your score breakdown, and keep your level saved to your account. More practice modes are coming soon.

payload.name: Elicit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Elicit's MCP server gives AI assistants direct access to a corpus of over 125 million academic papers. Search for relevant literature using natural language queries, create structured reports that extract and synthesize data across papers, and retrieve detailed report results — all programmatically. Built for life sciences R&D workflows, the server enables agents to rapidly survey evidence, compare findings across studies, and surface key data points without manual literature review, accelerating everything from target discovery to systematic evidence assessment.

payload.name: Legal Data Hunter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Legal Data Hunter connects ChatGPT to the world's fastest-growing open legal corpus — a continuously-updated index of 32M+ documents from 180+ jurisdictions. LDH ingests directly from official registries — Légifrance, BOE, EUR-Lex, RIS, the Bundesgerichtshof, the European Court of Human Rights, and hundreds more — and exposes them through a focused tool surface: hybrid semantic + keyword search, citation resolution (ECLI, CELEX, case numbers, article references with 95% accuracy across 184 sources), full-text retrieval, and discovery tools that tell the assistant what we have for a jurisdiction before it queries.

Free tier covers 20 searches/day for punctual research needs; paid plans scale to 100,000/month. Used by lawyers, paralegals, and legal-tech builders worldwide.

payload.name: Self Plagiarism Checker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WordBinary Self Plagiarism Checker opens an interactive widget where users can paste two documents and identify repeated phrase combinations. It highlights matching phrases of four or more consecutive words, shows a similarity percentage, and lists matched phrase combinations for quick writing review. Pasted text is processed inside the widget UI and is not stored by the MCP server.

payload.name: Strive PDF Generator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create, edit, and download professional PDFs with graphs and math notation — all without leaving ChatGPT.
Describe what you need in plain language or use the built-in LaTeX editor, then download the final PDF instantly.

Example Prompts
  • Teachers:
"Create a quadratic equations worksheet PDF with 10 questions and include an answer key."
  • Parents:
"Here is my daughter's math exam. Create a math worksheet PDF with questions targeting her growth areas."
  • Students:
"Create a mock IB Physics exam PDF focused on kinematics."
  • Professors:
"Format this abstract and introduction into a two-column IEEE-style PDF with citation placeholders."
  • Professionals:
"Create a PDF résumé based on the following LinkedIn data."
  • Developers:
"Compile this LaTeX code and generate a polished PDF."

No more copying LaTeX into external tools. Edit, recompile, and refine PDFs entirely within ChatGPT. Advanced users can open the PDF in full screen to manually edit and recompile the LaTeX — all in one place.

Key Features
  • Natural language input – Just describe what you want to create
  • LaTeX-powered formatting – Clean, professional math notation
  • Instant PDF generation – Download your PDF in seconds
  • Flexible viewing options – Full-screen, distraction-free PDF and LaTeX view

payload.name: Midpage Legal Research
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect to an enterprise-grade database of case law, statutes, regulations, dockets, and more to enable complex legal research and writing workflows inside of ChatGPT.

payload.name: alphaXiv
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: alphaXiv helps users discover academic papers, read and query paper content, inspect linked GitHub repositories, and manage folders of saved papers through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: alphaXiv 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 发现学术论文，阅读和查询论文内容，查看关联的 GitHub 仓库，并管理已保存论文的文件夹。

payload.name: AnyLessonPlan for Teachers
payload.description: 为学校和班级生成教学内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AnyLessonPlan is a simple easy tool to help ChatGPT generate lesson plans!

e.g.

- "@AnyLessonPlan, I need to teach number bonds to my Grade 1 class"
- "Use @AnyLessonPlan to prepare a lesson on short story writing for my 12 year old class"

or, upload your lesson plan and ask

"This needs to be 20m shorter. Use @AnyLessonPlan"
payload.longDescription:
AnyLessonPlan 是一款简单易用的工具，帮助 ChatGPT 生成教案！

例如：

- “@AnyLessonPlan，我需要教 1 年级学生学习数的分解与组合”
- “使用 @AnyLessonPlan 为我的 12 岁学生准备一堂短篇小说写作课”

或者上传教案，然后提出请求

“这需要缩短 20m。使用 @AnyLessonPlan”

payload.name: Audioscrape
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Transcribe any recording, or search millions of moments from podcasts, city-council and county meetings, and Supreme Court hearings — with new episodes and meetings added every day.

Attach an audio file in the chat, or paste a direct link or a Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive share link, and get a private, speaker-attributed transcript you can question. Every recording you add goes into your own workspace, where the people, companies, and topics in it are linked into a knowledge graph — so the tenth recording is searchable alongside the first.

Ask what was said about anything and get answers with the speaker, the exact timestamp, and a link that jumps to the moment. Track what any person, company, or topic has said across every episode and every recording of your own.
payload.longDescription:
转写任何录音，或搜索播客、市议会及县级会议、最高法院听证中的数百万个片段——每天都有新节目和会议加入。

在聊天中附加音频文件，或粘贴直接链接、Google Drive、Dropbox 或 OneDrive 分享链接，即可获得标注说话人的私密转写文本，并针对内容提问。你添加的每段录音都会进入自己的工作区，其中的人物、公司和主题会关联成知识图谱——因此第十段录音可以与第一段一起搜索。

询问任何话题曾被如何讨论，获得包含说话人、精确时间戳及直达对应时刻链接的答案。追踪任何人物、公司或主题在每集节目以及你自己的每段录音中的相关发言。

payload.name: StudyMe.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StudyMe.ai turns your teaching ideas into interactive lessons in seconds.
It is completely free to create and share lessons with students. Tell StudyMe.ai what you want to teach — including topic, level, and goal — and it creates a ready-to-use lesson webpage your students can open from a single link.
Teachers can easily refine each lesson by prompting ChatGPT or by adjusting the final result with editing tools on StudyMe.ai.
Students learn actively through quizzes, calculations, drag-and-drop exercises, clear explanations, and instant positive feedback. The varied tasks help increase engagement, improve focus, and support deeper learning.
Lessons can be shared instantly via unique links, with no login required for students.
Ideal for teachers, tutors, and educators who want to create high-quality lessons quickly and easily.

payload.name: Wiley Scholar Gateway
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Wiley Scholar Gateway enables ChatGPT to generate responses grounded in peer-reviewed sources with verifiable citations and DOI links. The Wiley Scholar Gateway Connector searches literature from Wiley journals to deliver evidence-backed answers with complete source metadata. This enables you to verify that claims are backed with sourced research — ensuring your research meets professional research standards.

payload.name: Academic Writing Toolkit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Academic Writing Toolkit helps users review pasted academic writing materials in ChatGPT. It can audit citation consistency between draft prose and reading-note source lines, check conservative British English spelling, flag paragraph-level logic issues, validate BibTeX records offline, and create a standard reading-notes Markdown template.
payload.longDescription: Academic Writing Toolkit 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中审阅粘贴的学术写作材料。它可以核查草稿正文与阅读笔记来源条目之间的引用一致性、检查传统英式英语拼写、标记段落层面的逻辑问题、离线验证 BibTeX 记录，并创建标准阅读笔记 Markdown 模板。

payload.name: Sider Scholar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your AI Research Assistant lets you search 350M+ research papers, chat with large volumes of research PDFs, and save findings to your Wisebase (knowledge base).

1. Global Academic Search (Search & Read)
- Major Sources: Search 350M+ papers from Google Scholar, PubMed, arXiv, and more.
- Read Instantly: Access full papers instantly to verify findings.

2. Build Your Knowledge Base (Save & Collect)
- Save for Continuous Research: Save searched papers to Wisebase for continuous questioning and deep analysis of your findings.
- Save Chat History: Save key research discussions as editable documents to capture and refine insights.

3. Unified Knowledge Analysis (Agentic RAG)
- Chat with Your Collection: Analyze your entire collection simultaneously.
- Traceable Sources: Get grounded answers with precise Reference Indices to verify every claim.

4. Visual Knowledge Organization (Visualize & Explore)
- Knowledge Graphing: Instantly generate interactive graphs from any paper to explore definitions, cause-and-effect links, and concept hierarchies.

Ideal Use Cases: For researchers, PhD students, and academics who need to access massive academic sources and synthesize grounded arguments with precise citations.

How to Use in ChatGPT
1. Connect App: Connect Sider Scholar to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type “@Sider Scholar".

Sample Prompts
- Search Paper: “@Sider Scholar Search recent papers on 'LLM alignment' published in the last two years.”
- Chat with Knowledge Base: “@Sider Scholar Answer questions about 'CRISPR gene editing' using my Knowledge Base.”
- Visual Research: “@Sider Scholar Build a Knowledge Graph explaining key concepts in 'Reinforcement Learning'.”

payload.name: quran.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn ChatGPT into your AI-powered Quran study companion — trace themes across all 114 surahs, compare how classical and modern scholars interpret the same verse, unpack the depth and precision behind the Quran's eloquence, and contextualize difficult passages with real, authentic tafsir commentary. All data sourced from quran.com, so every verse, scholarly opinion, interpretation, and linguistic detail the AI cites is verified — not guessed from training data.

payload.name: Udemy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Learn skills that move you forward with the Udemy app in ChatGPT. With Udemy, you can turn your curiosity, questions, and “I need to figure this out” moments into real progress.

Just tell ChatGPT what you want to learn, and the Udemy app helps you discover courses and video previews from real-world experts. Explore what skills you can learn, how the course is structured, and if it fits your goals — before diving in.

Millions of learners around the world use Udemy to build practical skills for work and life. Now, finding the right course happens where learning begins, so you can keep moving forward.

payload.name: Music Block
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Music Block turns music ideas in ChatGPT into playable sheet music and TAB.

Ask for guitar licks, piano voicings, bass lines, drum grooves, melodies, chord progressions, exercises, arrangements, or music theory examples, and Music Block renders them as engraved notation directly in the conversation.

Try prompts like “give me 5 melodic minor licks over B7alt,” “write a walking bass line over a ii–V–I,” “show me jazz piano voicings with smooth voice leading,” or “arrange this melody for string quartet.”

Music Block supports guitar, bass, ukulele, piano and keyboards, drums, strings, brass, woodwinds, saxophones, and voices. Guitar, bass, and ukulele examples include TAB; keyboards use a grand staff; ensembles can contain up to eight parts.

Every example includes playback, so you can hear what you are learning, change the tempo, and mute or solo individual parts. You can also work with alternate tunings, extended-range guitars and basses, swing and shuffle rhythms, tuplets, chord symbols, and common guitar techniques such as bends, slides, hammer-ons, and pull-offs.

Use Music Block for practice, teaching, songwriting, arranging, and exploring music theory with short, original examples created for your conversation.

payload.name: italki language learning
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: italki is an easy and flexible way to learn languages through one-on-one online lessons and group classes with native teachers. Customize your learning experience to fit your schedule, level, goals, and budget, and pay per lesson with flexible class lengths. With 150+ languages and thousands of qualified teachers to choose from, italki helps you learn through real communication.

payload.name: Assessment Generator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Assessment Generator – powered by Colossyan is an AI-powered tool built for instructional designers who want to create high-quality assessments with speed and confidence. With minimal input and no complex setup, it turns source content (such as pasted text, files, or conversation context) into structured, high-quality assessment questions.

The app guides users through a single, focused interaction: choose what to assess, select question types and difficulty, and instantly receive a clean, editable set of assessment items. The outputs are presented in a document-like format with copy-ready questions, simple inline editing, and one clear next step: download as a PDF or continue building in Colossyan.

Supported assessment types
*  Multiple Choice (MCQ) - One or more correct answers from a list of options.
* Single Choice - Exactly one correct answer from multiple options.
* True / False - Binary statements evaluated as true or false.
payload.longDescription:
由 Colossyan 驱动的 Assessment Generator 是一款 AI 工具，专为希望快速、自信地创建高质量评估的教学设计师打造。只需少量输入，无需复杂设置，即可将源内容（如粘贴的文本、文件或对话上下文）转化为结构化的高质量评估问题。

应用通过一次专注的交互引导用户：选择评估内容、题型和难度，即时获得一组清晰、可编辑的评估题目。输出采用类似文档的格式，问题可直接复制，支持简单的行内编辑，并提供明确的下一步：下载为 PDF，或在 Colossyan 中继续构建。

支持的评估类型
* 多项选择题（MCQ）——从选项列表中选择一个或多个正确答案。
* 单项选择题——从多个选项中选择唯一正确答案。
* 判断题——判断陈述为真或假。

payload.name: QuizFlight
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
QuizFlight lets you turn text, documents, or presentations into live quizzes. You can generate questions, review them, and launch a live session.

Participants join using a link or PIN from their devices and answer questions in real time while the host runs the quiz.

This app focuses on creating and running live quiz sessions. Results and scores are displayed during the session.

payload.name: OpenAI Certified
payload.description: Learn practical AI skills inside ChatGPT and earn OpenAI Certified credentials.
payload.summaryOriginal: Learn practical AI skills inside ChatGPT and earn OpenAI Certified credentials.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Learn practical AI skills inside ChatGPT and earn OpenAI Certified credentials.

payload.name: Scholar Sidekick
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Audit a whole reference list in one request - up to 25 entries, each checked for fabrication and retraction, returned as a per-entry verdict table. Verify whether a single citation is real - it cross-checks the claimed title and authors against the actual record at the identifier, catching the common pattern where a real DOI is paired with a fabricated or mismatched title. Resolve a DOI, PMID, PMCID, ISBN, arXiv ID, ISSN, or ADS bibcode into a clean, formatted citation in Vancouver, APA, AMA, IEEE, CSE, or any of 10,000+ CSL styles. Check whether a paper has been retracted, corrected, or had an expression of concern raised. Works in Codex too: ask the coding agent to verify the references in a manuscript or .bib file while it works. Results show in a citation card with the verdict, the formatted reference, and the source identifier. $0 - no account and no API key required.

payload.name: Mynawoo AI Language Tutor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Mynawoo helps authenticated learners start and continue a personal language-learning plan in ChatGPT. Learners can confirm their explanation language and course, take a private placement assessment or begin at A1, get chat lesson explanations, create private grammar practice completed in Mynawoo, and manage Leitner vocabulary plus coaching suggestions. Course-content access remains subject to the learner's Mynawoo plan.

payload.name: DataCamp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Give your AI assistant direct access to DataCamp's full catalog of courses, tutorials, projects, and exercises. Search by keyword, look up any course or exercise by ID, or retrieve summaries on demand—no sign-in required. Authenticate to unlock team admin: manage groups, members, and assignments. Run live reporting on progress, engagement, and adoption to track how learning is landing across your organization.

payload.name: Coursera Learning
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Coursera Learning helps learners discover courses, videos, guided projects, and curricula; learn concepts in interactive sessions; and practice professional or technical skills in ChatGPT.

payload.name: Lurna
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn any topic into study-ready materials directly from ChatGPT. Lurna helps you generate interactive flashcard decks you can flip through in chat, plus structured Markdown study notes in a clean reader view. Review key concepts faster, then export decks and notes to app.lurna.co to keep learning with spaced repetition — making serious review a native part of your AI-study workflow.

You can use Lurna app to:

1. Exam prep — flashcards from a lecture topic
Use case: Turn a subject you’re studying into an interactive flashcard deck you can review in chat, then export to Lurna for spaced repetition.
Example prompt: “Create flashcards for my biology midterm on photosynthesis — cover the light reactions, Calvin cycle, and how ATP and NADPH are used. About 15 cards, exam-level.”

2. Deep-dive study notes from a conversation
Use case: After discussing a complex topic with AI, turn the explanation into structured, readable study notes with headings, tables, and summaries
Example prompt: “Write study notes on the causes and consequences of the 2008 financial crisis. Include key terms, a timeline, and a short summary I can review before class.”

3. Learn from uploaded materials — notes + flashcards
Use case: Upload readings, slides, or your own notes and convert them into study materials without reformatting by hand.
Example prompt: “Here are my uploaded lecture notes on CRISPR Cas9. First generate study notes, then create a flashcard set covering the most testable concepts.”

4. Quick review before an interview or certification
Use case: Rapidly build recall-focused flashcards for technical interviews, certifications, or vocabulary.
Example prompt: “Generate flashcards to help me prep for a AWS Solutions Architect interview — focus on S3, IAM, VPC, and common architecture tradeoffs.”

payload.name: Ace Quiz Maker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Stop passive reading and start active learning. Turn your PDFs, docs, and notes into interactive practice tests with instant scoring and detailed explanations—helping you master new materials in seconds.
- Upload & Generate: Simply upload your PDFs, notes, or guides. Quiz Maker analyzes your files to build custom tests instantly.
- Instant Explanations: Get detailed explanations for every wrong answer immediately to correct misconceptions.
- Scoring & Report: Track your progress with a final summary showing Score, Accuracy, and Time Spent.
- Review & Retake: Quizzes are automatically saved, so you can review later or retake them anytime to master the material.

Perfect Scenarios:
-Exam Prep:Ace exams like Driver's License, SATs, or Certifications. Upload study guides for rigorous practice.
-Study & Review: Paste notes or upload chapters to verify understanding of new materials in seconds.

How to Use in ChatGPT
1. Connect App: Connect Ace Quiz Maker to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type “@Ace Quiz Maker ”.
Sample prompts:
- Quiz from File: "@Ace Quiz Maker Generate a 10-question multiple choice quiz from this uploaded PDF."
- Topic Practice: "@Ace Quiz Maker Create a practice test about 'Python Programming Basics'."
payload.longDescription:
停止被动阅读，开始主动学习。将PDF、文档和笔记转为互动练习测试，提供即时评分和详细解释，帮助你在几秒内掌握新材料。
- 上传并生成：只需上传PDF、笔记或指南。Quiz Maker会分析文件，即时创建定制测试。
- 即时解释：每道错题都会立即提供详细解释，帮助纠正误解。
- 评分与报告：最终摘要显示分数、准确率和用时，便于追踪进度。
- 复习与重做：测验会自动保存，你可以稍后复习或随时重做，以掌握材料。

适用场景：
-备考：轻松应对驾驶执照、SAT或认证考试。上传学习指南，进行严格练习。
-学习与复习：粘贴笔记或上传章节，在几秒内检验对新材料的理解。

如何在ChatGPT中使用
1. 连接应用：将Ace Quiz Maker连接到ChatGPT。
2. 触发：输入“@Ace Quiz Maker ”。
示例提示词：
- 根据文件出题：“@Ace Quiz Maker 根据这个上传的PDF生成一份10题的选择题测验。”
- 主题练习：“@Ace Quiz Maker 创建一份关于‘Python编程基础’的练习测试。”

payload.name: getMindmap
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn ideas, notes, and study topics into structured mindmaps in ChatGPT. getMindmap creates clear branch-based maps you can review in chat and saves them to your account so you can keep editing later on map.getmindmap.com.

payload.name: Recall
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and manage spaced repetition flashcard decks in Recall directly from ChatGPT. Turn lecture notes, articles, or any conversation into rich cards in one request. ChatGPT designs the deck structure, writes atomic cards that follow proven memory-retention principles, and schedules them so you can start reviewing right away. Track your progress and surface your most difficult cards anytime.

payload.name: PokeBot.ai Career Coach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PokeBot adds purpose-built career-readiness workflows to ChatGPT. It evaluates your resume and interview answers against role-specific criteria, returning structured scores, evidence-backed gaps, and prioritized next steps instead of relying on one-off career prompts.

Match your resume against a job description, re-score it after edits to see what improved, run mock interviews with feedback on every answer, draft tailored cover letters, map your skill gaps, and build week-by-week growth plans. PokeBot covers quantitative finance, AI/ML, software engineering, data science, product management, finance, and more.

payload.name: Chessvia Openings
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore a library of chess openings and their variations. See the exact move sequences for popular openings like the Sicilian Defense, Italian Game, and Queen's Gambit displayed on an interactive chess board.

Whether you're preparing for a game or studying opening theory, Chessvia Openings helps you quickly look up and visualize the key moves that define each opening line.

payload.name: Descrybe Legal Engine
payload.description: 原始法律资料研究工具包
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Descrybe Legal Engine brings U.S. primary-law research tools into ChatGPT. Use it to search legal authority, resolve citations, retrieve case details and source passages, check case treatment and citing authorities, and verify quoted legal language. It helps legal professionals and serious legal researchers move from a question to primary legal sources they can read and verify.
payload.longDescription: Descrybe Legal Engine 将美国原始法律资料研究工具带入 ChatGPT。可用于检索法律依据、解析引注、获取案件详情和来源原文段落、检查后续判例如何对待该案及哪些法律资料引用了它，并核实所引用的法律表述。它帮助法律专业人士和严谨的法律研究者，从问题出发找到可阅读、可核验的原始法律资料。

payload.name: Chymia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Chymia is an interactive, AI-powered virtual laboratory that lets you explore the thermodynamics and behavior of chemical elements in real-time. 
Whether you want to boil gold, compress hydrogen into a solid, or trigger fascinating chemical reactions and uncover the unique curiosities of each element, Chymia makes it visually engaging and scientifically accurate.

payload.name: Course Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Course Outline Generator helps you instantly create structured training outlines for corporate learning, compliance, onboarding, and upskilling. Just describe what you want to teach, who it’s for, and how long the course should be and get a ready-to-use blueprint with clearly defined lessons. 

What you can do
* Generate structured course outlines from a single prompt
* Define learning goals, audience, and course duration
* Upload reference material (PDF or text) or use your chat context
* Expand and review lessons one by one
* Further edit and export your outline as a PDF file

Perfect for
* L&D and HR teams
* Managers and team leads
* Compliance and security training
* Soft-skills and leadership development
* Corporate onboarding and upskilling

Once your outline is ready, you can seamlessly continue building your full course with Colossyan’s interactive course creator.

payload.name: Studocu
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Studocu helps students find study documents, set course context, ground answers from the open web, and manage authenticated study projects—attaching sources, reading artifacts, creating quizzes or mock exams, and keeping durable study memory—through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Amass
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Amass connects your assistant to six curated biomedical corpora: BioMedCore (43M+ records: peer-reviewed publications from PubMed/PMC and conference abstracts from society meetings), TrialCore (1.2M+ clinical trials from ClinicalTrials.gov and the WHO ICTRP), DrugCore (22K+ harmonized drugs/molecules covering modality, clinical stage, structure, synonyms, and the gene targets each drug acts on; ChEMBL-linked), RegulatoryCore (7K+ unified FDA + EMA marketing authorizations with source documents such as labels, reviews, SmPCs, and EPARs), GeneCore (43K+ harmonized human genes with a target-intelligence layer covering druggability, DepMap essentiality, ChEMBL target class, clinical-precedent tractability, curated safety liabilities, and gnomAD constraint), and PatentCore (preview, life-science patents with full-text search, CPC/IPC classifications, assignees/inventors, and patent families). Users can search and retrieve full records with filters that beat open-web retrieval, and follow cross-links across corpora back to each underlying source.
payload.longDescription: Amass 将你的助手连接到 6 个精选生物医学语料库：BioMedCore（43M+ 条记录：来自 PubMed/PMC 的同行评审出版物，以及学术协会会议摘要）、TrialCore（来自 ClinicalTrials.gov 和 WHO ICTRP 的 1.2M+ 项临床试验）、DrugCore（22K+ 种经过统一整理的药物/分子，涵盖药物类型、临床阶段、结构、同义名称及每种药物作用的基因靶点；与 ChEMBL 关联）、RegulatoryCore（7K+ 条统一整理的 FDA + EMA 上市许可，包含药品标签、审评文件、SmPC 和 EPAR 等源文件）、GeneCore（43K+ 个人类基因，经过统一整理，并提供靶点情报层，涵盖成药性、DepMap 必需性、ChEMBL 靶点类别、临床先例所体现的可开发性、经整理的安全风险和 gnomAD 约束），以及 PatentCore（预览版，生命科学专利，支持全文搜索、CPC/IPC 分类、受让人/发明人和专利族）。用户可以使用优于开放网络检索的筛选条件搜索和获取完整记录，并沿着语料库之间的交叉链接追溯到各自的底层来源。

payload.name: SkinKnowledgeBase
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SkinKnowledgeBase is a public skincare knowledge website and AI-accessible reference layer for answering skincare and skincare-product questions with source-backed context.

For AI assistants, it provides read-only MCP access to the same public knowledge structure, so answers can include canonical SkinKnowledgeBase URLs, citations where available, product facts, ingredient context, comparison caveats, and clear uncertainty when source information is limited.
SkinKnowledgeBase is designed for transparent cosmetic-skincare reference, not medical advice. It avoids fake ratings, paid rankings, guaranteed outcomes, and unsupported “best overall” claims. It is useful for shoppers, researchers, content teams, and AI assistants that need grounded skincare context instead of vague beauty claims.

payload.name: Studyportals

payload.name: Metronome: Music tempo+beat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Metronome

Need a steady beat? This metronome is ready to help. Pick a speed, press start, and follow the click. It is made for music practice that is easy, clear, and fun.

You can use it for almost any instrument. Play piano, guitar, drums, violin, bass, ukulele, flute, trumpet, saxophone, cello, or any other instrument. You can also use it for singing, dancing, clapping, marching, or learning rhythm. If you want to stay on the beat, this metronome can help.

Choose your tempo in BPM, which means beats per minute. Want to play slowly? Pick a low number. Want to play fast? Pick a high number. You are in control. Change the speed whenever you want until it feels just right.

If you do not know the BPM you need, use tap tempo. Tap along with the beat you hear in your head. The metronome will help find the speed for you. It is quick, simple, and useful.

Practice one step at a time. Start slow so your hands learn the notes. When you can play without mistakes, make the tempo a little faster. Keep doing this until you reach your goal. Small steps help you get better.

A steady beat is one of the best ways to improve. It helps your timing, rhythm, and confidence. It also helps you play with other people because everyone follows the same beat.

This metronome works well for beginners, students, teachers, hobby players, and professional musicians. It is useful during lessons, rehearsals, warm-ups, concerts, and daily practice. Whether you play for five minutes or five hours, a steady beat makes practice more helpful.

Use it to learn new songs. Use it to fix hard parts. Use it to build speed without rushing. Use it to make tricky rhythms easier to understand. You can even use it to keep a steady pace while reading music or practicing scales, chords, arpeggios, and exercises.

Different songs need different speeds. A slow ballad feels different from a fast rock song. Classical music, jazz, pop, folk, blues, country, hip-hop, and many other styles all use tempo. Finding the right BPM helps music sound the way it should.

Teachers can use this metronome in class. Students can use it at home. Bands can use it during rehearsal. Choirs can practice together. Drum lines can stay together. Solo musicians can improve their timing. Anyone who wants a steady beat can use it.

If you are learning rhythm, ask questions. If you are not sure what BPM to use, ask for help. If you want practice ideas, ask. You can also ask about note values, rests, counting, time signatures, subdivisions, swing feel, accents, or ways to practice difficult rhythms. Simple answers make learning easier.

Try setting small goals. Play one line correctly three times. Raise the BPM by a few beats. Repeat until you reach your target speed. Slow practice is not weak practice. It is smart practice.

Remember to relax while you play. Breathe normally. Keep good posture. Listen carefully to every click. Try to match each note to the beat instead of chasing it. Good timing comes from careful listening and steady practice.

This metronome is designed to be simple. You do not need special music knowledge to begin. Just choose a tempo, start the beat, and play. You can change the speed whenever you need. The goal is to make practice easier, clearer, and more enjoyable.

Whether you are learning your first song, preparing for an audition, practicing with a band, getting ready for a concert, or simply working on better rhythm, this metronome is here to help. Keep the beat. Stay steady. Practice a little every day. Small improvements grow into big results, and every beat brings you one step closer to becoming a stronger, more confident musician.

你将获得：
• 判定——基于对抗式 AI 辩论给出真 / 假 / 不确定及置信度评分
• 证据——支持或反对主张的来源，并附可信度评分

payload.name: Emona
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Emona helps create social stories, visual schedules, and step-by-step guides for children, including children with autism, who benefit from clear routines and preparation. It can support everyday activities, transitions, and new situations by explaining what to expect in simple, calm language.

Try asking:

Create a story about going to the dentist
Make a visual schedule for a school day
Help me prepare my child for a new activity

payload.name: Edvoy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Edvoy helps students discover universities and courses, check indicative study-abroad eligibility, review application and visa guidance, explore scholarships and destinations, and request contact from an Edvoy counsellor after consent.

payload.name: Particl Market Research
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Particl Market Research helps teams answer ecommerce research questions directly in ChatGPT. It supports company discovery, product catalog research, product detail and variant analysis, market leader discovery, market trend analysis, marketing asset discovery, retail event tracking, sales timeseries, and product mix breakdowns.

The app uses your authenticated Particl account and returns structured market intelligence data from Particl APIs.

payload.name: Khan Academy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your go-to tool for high-quality math practice. Access trusted K–12 math questions from Khan Academy. Generate practice by grade, topic, or standard in seconds and assign it to your Khan Academy classroom to support targeted instruction and save planning time.

payload.name: Açık Silivri Havadis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Açık Silivri Havadis gives ChatGPT read-only access to public court records from the Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality trial, including hearings, attendees, transcript search, accusations, defenses, evidence, statements, expert opinions, and cross-examinations.
payload.longDescription: Açık Silivri Havadis让ChatGPT以只读方式访问伊斯坦布尔大都会市政府审判的公开庭审记录，包括庭审、出席人员、庭审转录搜索、指控、辩护、证据、陈述、专家意见和交叉询问。

payload.name: Any Fact Widget
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A great way to learn fun facts with ChatGPT!

e.g.

- "Tell me a @Any Fact Widget  about dolphins"
- "Give me a random fact @Any Fact Widget"
- "@Any Fact Widget, how quickly does Mars go round the Sun?"
payload.longDescription:
与 ChatGPT 一起学习有趣知识的好方法！

例如：

- “用 @Any Fact Widget 告诉我一个关于海豚的事实”
- “给我一个随机事实 @Any Fact Widget”
- “@Any Fact Widget，火星绕太阳一周要多久？”

payload.name: API Lessons
payload.description: 寻找 API 和 MCP 培训
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A comprehensive list of free, short Lightning Lessons on the Maven education platform by Emmanuel Paraskakis. The topics covered are APIs, MCP, Product Management, Technical PM Careers, and ChatGPT Apps.
Users can either view a recording, sign up for an upcoming live lesson, or learn which cohort-based course is connected to the topic so they can go deeper into it.
Lightning Lessons are conducted over Zoom and are practical and hands-on with skills you can use immediately. They are meant for tech-savvy mid-career professionals, especially those in the technology or software industry. They are conducted exclusively in the English language.
The main Instructor is Emmanuel Paraskakis, an entrepreneur, product management executive, and consultant at Level 250 with over 15 years of experience shaping products.
payload.longDescription:
提供 Emmanuel Paraskakis 在 Maven 教育平台上的免费、简短 Lightning Lessons 完整列表。主题包括 API、MCP、产品管理、技术产品经理职业发展和 ChatGPT Apps。
用户可以观看录像、报名即将举行的直播课程，或了解与主题相关的分期成班课程，以便深入学习。
Lightning Lessons 通过 Zoom 开展，重视实操，所学技能可立即应用。课程面向熟悉技术的职业中期专业人士，尤其是技术或软件行业从业者。全部课程仅使用英语授课。
主讲教师 Emmanuel Paraskakis 是企业家、产品管理高管和 Level 250 顾问，拥有超过 15 年的产品塑造经验。

payload.name: Article Galaxy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Check article availability of scientific articles, confirm access and reuse rights, and order documents through your Article Galaxy account without leaving the conversation. Ordered PDFs are delivered through Article Galaxy under your existing entitlements; the connector handles availability, rights, ordering, and delivery.
payload.longDescription: 无需离开对话，即可检查科学文章的可获取情况、确认访问和再使用权，并通过 Article Galaxy 账户订购文档。订购的PDF会按照你现有的授权权益通过 Article Galaxy 交付；连接器负责可获取情况、权限、订购和交付。

payload.name: Tailo Lens
Trivana Study — Quiz My Notes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn what you're learning into a quiz you can actually play.

Paste a short note, add fuller notes, name a subject, share a supported public webpage, or ask ChatGPT to use relevant text it can read from an attached file. Trivana Study creates one unlisted 5-, 7-, or 10-question practice quiz with automatic scoring, an AI host, and a play link for you or your study group.

Short note seeds may be supplemented with verified, well-established subject knowledge so there is enough material for a complete round. Fuller notes and supported webpages remain grounded in the supplied source. If you ask to use only the supplied material, Study keeps that strict boundary and may ask for more material.

Answer a warm-up in ChatGPT, then open the full quiz—players need no account. Sofia hosts by default, or choose from 8 personalities in 10 supported languages. If Save & track scores appears, you can claim the quiz and keep plays, scores, and replays.

Unlisted means anyone with the link can play, but the quiz is not automatically featured publicly. For attached files, ChatGPT may send extracted or condensed text; Trivana does not receive the raw attachment. Built for lecture review, class revision, exam and certification practice, and quick checks of what actually stuck.

payload.name: Common Room
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Embed complete buyer intelligence directly within ChatGPT. Research accounts and contacts, surface buying signals, and browse activity history - all through natural language. Build prospect lists of net-new companies by industry, size, tech stack, or location. Filter and sort contacts by segment, role, lead score, or website visits. Every result is grounded in real context, real prioritization, and real revenue opportunity directly from your CRM fields, scores, enrichment, and signals - so you always know what's actually happening in your accounts.

You can use the Common Room to:
- Account Research: "Tell me about Datadog and create a plan on how to approach the account."
- Contact Lookup: "Research jane.doe@company.com using Common Room."
- Prospecting: "Find SaaS companies in the US using Snowflake with 200-1000 employees."
- Segment and Role Filtering: "Show me all Economic Buyers in my 'Champions changing jobs' segment."
- High-Intent Contacts: "Find contacts at ICP companies who have visited our pricing page this week."
- Website Visitor Tracking: "Who visited our pricing page in the last 7 days?"

payload.name: Lune
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lune connects ChatGPT with research knowledge and tools built for scientific workflows. Ask a question in plain English, and Lune retrieves relevant papers from top-tier academic conferences, complete with abstracts, metadata, citation links, and full text when available. It also provides curated guidance for literature reviews, evaluation design, ablation studies, and venue selection. From early ideas to publication-ready research, Lune helps researchers and technical teams move faster with traceable sources, deeper literature grounding, and more rigorous, evidence-backed decisions.

payload.name: Spanish Law Research
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Spanish Law Research helps users find Spanish legislation, inspect law metadata and article text, retrieve source-grounded excerpts, and review reform history with citations to BOE, and source URLs. 

The app is a read-only legal research assistant and does not provide legal advice, submit forms, or change any government or third-party system.

payload.name: NYCU Library
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your library and research companion for National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU) — access library services and academic resources without leaving ChatGPT.

Search the library catalog for books, journals, and dissertations across NYCU and the Taiwan United University System (UST). Check your personal dashboard — active loans, due dates, holds, and purchase requests — at a glance. Dive into academic research with Semantic Scholar integration: search papers, read abstracts, explore citations and references, and discover similar work.

Features:
- Library catalog search (physical and online, filter by campus and format)
- Personal library dashboard: loans, due dates, holds, purchase requests

Results appear in interactive widgets — book cards and a personal account view — making library research feel native to your conversation. 
Built for NYCU students, researchers, and staff.

payload.name: Drill
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Drill connects ChatGPT to a knowledge-verification protocol for students. Create Cards with Truths and plausible Traps, organize Decks and Tags, inspect what is Untested, Weak, Unproven, or Mastered, and turn course material into study content that can be tested before exam day.

payload.name: Pencil Spaces
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pencil Spaces is the best place for teaching virtually. Deliver engaging lessons in our virtual classroom, automate operations, and keep everyone safe and compliant.

payload.name: Glossarize
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
An easy way to see what words mean in the chat.

e.g. 

- "How does a plant turn sunlight into energy? Include a glossary."
- "Show me a glossary of common computing terms"
- "Show me Hamlet's 'To Be or Not to Be speech with a glossary for the old English words"

payload.name: GovQuery
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GovQuery is a powerful search engine that makes U.S. government reports and data easier to explore, locate, and understand.
 
Built by the Program Integrity Alliance, GovQuery processes over 300,000 articles, reports, and oversight recommendations to make them more digestible for AI platforms — offering deeper, more targeted search than general-purpose engines. Every result links to the exact page where content appears, and you can filter by granular categories unavailable on the source platforms.
 
Data sources currently include:
 
- Reports from the Government Accountability Office (GAO), federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), and the Congressional Research Service (CRS)
- Department of Justice press releases
- Executive orders (last six presidents)
- Annual federal CJ/AFR/PAR agency reports (since 2019 for Chief Financial Officers (CFO) Act of 1990)
 
GovQuery also includes all open oversight recommendations from the GAO and federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), with tools to analyze them by category and track trends over time.
 
New data sources are added regularly.
 
You can register for a free account at: https://www.programintegrity.org (click on the person icon top-right)

For more information on GovQuery data, please see our FAQ (https://www.programintegrity.org/faq).

payload.name: Bodhaka Virtual Labs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bodhaka brings interactive physics and chemistry lab canvases into ChatGPT. Students build circuits, mechanics, and optics diagrams in the Physics Lab, or atoms, bonds, and balanced equations in the Chemistry Lab, all by hand on a drawing canvas inside the chat. The labs are fully interactive and render consistently on both web and mobile. Built by the team behind bodhaka.org for real, hands-on learning.
payload.longDescription: Bodhaka 将交互式物理和化学实验画布带入 ChatGPT。学生可以在物理实验室构建电路、力学和光学图示，或在化学实验室构建原子、化学键和平衡方程式，全都在聊天内的绘图画布上手动完成。实验室完全支持交互，并在 Web 和移动端保持一致的呈现效果。由 bodhaka.org 背后的团队打造，支持真正的动手学习。

payload.name: Cody Reading
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cody Reading helps reading specialists, tutors, classroom teachers, and interventionists create and evaluate decodable stories aligned to UFLI Foundations lessons. Users can find relevant UFLI lesson numbers, generate lesson-aligned stories from a topic, revise generated or pasted stories while preserving lesson alignment, and analyze existing passages for decodability. Results render in an interactive story viewer with a decodability score, word-category highlighting, challenge-word review, and a printable PDF link.

payload.name: BestColleges.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BestColleges makes it easy to find accredited online programs that fit your goals.

Whether you’re exploring options or ready to take the next step, this is a quick, straightforward way to see what’s available from our catalog of trusted university partners. Built for students and working adults who want clear guidance and faster paths to the right online degree.
payload.longDescription:
BestColleges 让你轻松找到符合目标、获得认证的在线课程项目。

无论你正在探索选项，还是准备迈出下一步，都可以通过这种快速、直接的方式查看可信大学合作伙伴目录中的项目。专为希望获得清晰指导、更快找到合适在线学位的学生和在职成年人打造。

payload.name: Examen Civique
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Prepare for the French civic exam for naturalisation française, a carte de séjour pluriannuelle, or a carte de résident.

Personalise your preparation by choosing your exam type and target date, then follow a preparation plan recommended by Alice.

Practise with 20-question series, see your score instantly, review clear explanations in French or English, replay series whenever needed, explore more than 190 questions with short video answers, and access realistic timed mock exams in Alice.

payload.name: monPIF
edifyedu.in
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your complete guide to online education in India. Search and compare 125+ UGC-DEB approved online universities. Get verified fees, NAAC accreditation grades, NIRF rankings, and programme details for MBA, BBA, MCA, and BCA courses. Check if any university is genuinely approved by UGC-DEB. Compare universities side by side on fees, rankings, and specialisations. All information is verified from official sources and updated regularly. edifyedu.in is India's independent, commission-free online education platform with no paid rankings.

payload.name: Lingard
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lingard Vocab brings ChatGPT into the Lingard way of learning: reading and listening to content you actually enjoy. Instead of studying disconnected flashcards, you can ask ChatGPT to build vocabulary around the real things you want to understand: books, articles, podcasts, movie and TV plots, travel plans, work topics, and everyday situations. Lingard Vocab can save polished study cards straight to your Lingard library with translations, pronunciation, part of speech, synonyms, grammar details, highlighted example sentences, and language-specific details such as German noun articles. Then you continue learning in Lingard with instant lookup, contextual translation, audio, spaced repetition, progress tracking, and sync across your devices. The app connects through scoped OAuth and only reads or updates your Lingard vocabulary when you ask.

payload.name: Parenting Hub
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Parenting Hub helps parents find source-linked guidance for baby feeding, first foods, postpartum health, safety questions, and next steps. It shows practical answer cards, baby and toddler recipe details, ingredients, steps, allergens, nutrition notes, and safety guidance when relevant. It is educational and does not replace clinical care.

payload.name: College Vidya
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find your perfect online degree without the research fatigue. This interactive app brings verified data from College Vidya directly into your chat, allowing you to search top universities, compare tuition fees side-by-side, and explore granular course structures in a clean dashboard. No biased rankings, no hidden costs—just honest, structured data to help you make the right choice for your education.

payload.name: The Princeton Review
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Start your SAT prep with The Princeton Review, the name students have trusted for over 40 years. Get expert-built guidance on the test — right where you're already studying.

Ask about:
•	What's on the SAT and how it's structured
•	How to begin your prep
•	Strategies and study approaches
•	Math, reading, and writing sections
•	Expert breakdowns of example questions

The Princeton Review brings the same expertise behind our courses, one-on-one tutoring, and books into your study flow, helping you learn to master the SAT with clarity and confidence.

payload.name: Dow Jones Factiva
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Factiva Connector, enables authorized users to search Factiva’s global news archive, including premium Dow Jones sources, and incorporate insights from that content into their ChatGPT responses.  

Users can research companies, industries, and markets and ground their  answers in licensed content, complete with citations and direct links to original articles.

A subscription to Factiva is required. 

Factiva content may not be shared outside your organization or used for machine learning or AI training purposes. This connector may only be used with your organization’s ChatGPT instance.

payload.name: Dewey Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Built for academic researchers, the Dewey app lets you search and explore datasets on the Dewey Platform without leaving ChatGPT. Ask in plain language, get back dataset details, coverage summaries, schemas, and downloadable samples. Spend less time hunting for data and more time using it. Trusted by thousands of academics across 500+ universities, Dewey unlocks 30+ premium data providers through one subscription.

payload.name: Sketchy Medical
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sketchy is a visual learning platform trusted by medical, PA, NP, and MCAT students. This connector gives you direct access to Sketchy's full lesson and case library so you can find exactly what you need and jump straight into studying.

What you can do:

Find the sketch that teaches a concept: "How does Sketchy teach beta-lactam antibiotics?"
Decode a symbol: "What does the golden staff mean in the S. aureus sketch?"
Zero in on weak spots: "I missed hyperkalemia EKG changes on my practice test. Which sketch covers it?"
Practice on real presentations: "Find me a Sketchy Case with a patient in DKA."
Plan your study schedule: "I have a pharmacology exam in 3 weeks, what should I watch and in what order?"
Map your syllabus: "Make a study schedule of Sketchy lessons that aligns to this course syllabus"


The connector searches across all Sketchy content, including Microbiology, Pharmacology, Pathophysiology, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Pediatrics, OB/GYN, Psychiatry, and more. Results include cover images, chapter context, and direct links that open in Sketchy (sign-in required to watch). Supported programs: Medical (Step 1/Step 2), PA, NP, and MCAT.

Note: This is a read-only connector. It helps you find and navigate to Sketchy content, but you'll need a Sketchy account to access the linked content.

payload.name: LingoStar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LingoStar helps learners manage language learning tracks, change settings conversationally, and practice language information, listening, reading, writing, and speaking inside ChatGPT, using ChatGPT's intelligence.

payload.name: LeapScholar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search and compare university programs abroad — by country, discipline, intake, and
degree level — directly inside ChatGPT.
LeapScholar connects to a curated database of universities across the UK, USA, Canada,
Ireland, Australia, Germany, and more. Ask a question like:
• “Data Science programs in the UK”
• “Computer Science universities in USA for January 2027 intake”
• “Compare Finance programs in UK vs Canada”
• “1-year postgraduate Computer Science programs in Ireland for September 2026”
Results appear as interactive cards showing university name, course, tuition fee, duration,
ranking, and intake periods. Tap any card to visit the university’s program page for full
details.
This tool is read-only. It does not require login, does not store any user data, and only
queries LeapScholar’s internal university database.
